title: Michelle Trachtenberg, ‘Harriet the Spy’ and ‘Buffy’ Star, Dies at 39
text:
• Michelle Trachtenberg passed away at the age of 39.
• She was known for her roles in the 1996 film 'Harriet the Spy' and the television series 'Buffy the Vampire Slayer' and 'Gossip Girl.'
• Trachtenberg was found unresponsive in her Manhattan apartment on February 26, 2025.
• The New York Police Department confirmed that officers responded to a 911 call reporting her unconscious.
• Emergency medical services pronounced her dead at the scene.
• Authorities stated that no foul play is suspected in her death.
• The New York Medical Examiner's office is conducting an examination to determine the cause of death.
• Trachtenberg's representative requested privacy for her family during this time.
• Her career began at age 8 with a role in 'The Adventures of Pete & Pete' from 1994 to 1996.
• She starred in 'Inspector Gadget' and earned a Daytime Emmy nomination in 2001 for hosting 'Truth or Scare.'
• Trachtenberg joined 'Buffy the Vampire Slayer' in 2000 as Dawn Summers and remained until the show's conclusion in 2003.
• She supported co-star Sarah Michelle Gellar after Gellar spoke out against Joss Whedon in 2021.
• Trachtenberg received a Teen Choice Award nomination for her role as Georgina Sparks in 'Gossip Girl.'
• She reprised her role in the 2021 'Gossip Girl' revival.
• Tributes poured in from fellow actors, including Blake Lively and David Boreanaz.
• Trachtenberg's filmography includes roles in 'Ice Princess,' 'EuroTrip,' and '17 Again.'
• She hosted the true-crime docuseries 'Meet, Marry, Murder' on Tubi.
• Her legacy includes advocacy for safer working conditions in Hollywood.
